task.description: Hard gate on TEST-DESIGNER's output for REQ-036 (33 tests across 3 files + test/specs/REQ-036.md). Read the spec and all 3 test files independently -- do not trust TEST-DESIGNER's own handoff summary. Verify against REQ-036's actual 6 acceptance_criteria in docs/requirements.yaml and the validated design at lib/letflow/design/promotion_plan.md. Specifically re-check: every compute_promotion_plan/5 call site actually supplies opts[:permission_checker] (grep for calls without it), AC3's test genuinely injects opts[:tenant_classifier] rather than relying on a nonexistent working default, the 2 differently-key-ordered digest examples are genuinely independently constructed (not trivial permutations of the same one-line map), and fixtures use per-test unique tenant data (no shared hardcoded tenant IDs across tests, which would cause cross-test pollution against the real Postgres this codebase's tests run against).
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-036 acceptance criterion has at least one runnable test that would actually fail if the behavior were violated (not just a test that happens to pass)
No 'TODO: implement test' or skipped test left anywhere in the 3 test files
Test fixtures use per-test unique tenant/data -- verify directly, not on trust
Tests are self-sufficient -- don't depend on other tests running first or on shared mutable state
No hardcoded secrets/connection strings in any test file
Independently re-run MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test on the 3 new files and confirm the reported 33/33 pass count is real

result.summary: Independently re-verified all 6 checks against test/specs/REQ-036.md and the 3 test files (read directly, not from TEST-DESIGNER's handoff). (1) Every compute_promotion_plan/5 call site (9 total) supplies opts[:permission_checker] except the one deliberate KeyError test that omits it to prove there is no silent default -- verified by grep. (2) AC3's test at promotion_plan_test.exs:353-371 explicitly injects opts[:tenant_classifier] returning :production; the companion test at 373-395 correctly omits it to exercise the real default (:test), matching design section 9.2's stated limitation. (3) The 2 AC5 digest examples are genuinely independent: example 1 is a single graph_node entry with a 2-level nested `after` map; example 2 is a two-entry plan (service_binding + module_ref) with a 3-level-deep nested `before.meta.owner` map -- different shapes/content/depth, not a copy-pasted permutation. (4) Fixtures are per-test unique: every provisioned_tenant() call inserts a fresh Tenant with a System.unique_integer-suffixed slug, every process_key via unique_process_key()/System.unique_integer, no hardcoded tenant IDs or process keys shared across tests or files; on_exit/1 drops each schema and deletes tenant/registration rows. (5) grep for 'TODO: implement test', '@tag :skip', '@tag :pending' across the spec and all 3 test files: zero hits. (6) grep for password/secret/connection-string/api-key patterns across the 3 test files: zero hits. Independently re-ran `MIX_TEST_PARTITION=2 mix test test/letflow/definitions/promotion_plan_test.exs test/letflow/definitions/promotion_conflict_test.exs test/letflow/definitions/promotion_digest_test.exs` twice (once plain, once with --seed 0): both runs report '33 tests, 0 failures', confirming the reported 33/33 pass count is real, not fabricated. Not a WF-03 regression test, so the pre-fix-failure check does not apply. All 6 of REQ-036's acceptance criteria in docs/requirements.yaml map to concrete, independently-verified test coverage per the design's own section 10 mapping.
